evidence_limits: This command verifies archived bytes, checksums, and deterministic replay. It does not rerun inference or prove current hardware performance.
The canonical v1.1 measurements came from one GitHub-hosted Ubuntu 24.04 Arm64 runner with a Neoverse-N2 CPU.
The v1.4 capacity result is a bounded, closed-loop fixed-concurrency study on one runner. It is not an open-loop production-capacity, cost, energy, or MLPerf claim.
The KleidiAI log marker shows that llama.cpp reported a CPU_KLEIDIAI model buffer. It is not kernel-level acceleration proof.
